FX-SHAKE-001.says: The settings as they start: amount 10, rotation 0, hold 1, seed 0. Each frame the drawing jolts to a new place, up to 10 pixels each way, larger than the drawing itself: frame 0 moves it 0.57 pixels left and 2.96 down, frame 1 9.51 right and 9.94 up, out of the frame, so frame 1 is empty, frame 2 6.04 left and 1.57 up, frame 3 1.54 right and 0.47 down, and frame 4 8.05 left and 6.89 down.

FX-SHAKE-002.says: Amount 0 and rotation 0: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-SHAKE-003.says: Amount 2: the same jolts at a fifth of the size, so the drawing stays in the frame and each frame shows it moved a little differently, by a fifth of FX-SHAKE-001's move: frame 0 by 0.11 left and 0.59 down, frame 1 by 1.90 right and 1.99 up.

FX-SHAKE-004.says: Amount 2, hold 2: each jolt is kept for two frames, a shake on twos: frames 0 and 1 are FX-SHAKE-003's frame 0, frames 2 and 3 its frame 1, and frame 4 its frame 2.

FX-SHAKE-005.says: Amount 2, hold 5: one jolt kept for all five frames, each FX-SHAKE-003's frame 0.

FX-SHAKE-006.says: Amount 2, hold 1.9, floored to 1: FX-SHAKE-003 exactly.

FX-SHAKE-007.says: Amount 2, seed 1: another shake, frame 0 moving the drawing 1.18 pixels left and 1.72 up where FX-SHAKE-003's frame 0 moves it down.

FX-SHAKE-008.says: Amount 2, seed 1.6, floored to 1: FX-SHAKE-007 exactly.

FX-SHAKE-009.says: Amount 0, rotation 10: the drawing is not moved, only turned about its centre, frame 0 by 9.61 degrees anticlockwise, so the blue band tilts up to the right, and frame 2 by 3.47 degrees clockwise, so it tilts down to the right.

FX-SHAKE-010.says: Amount 2, rotation 10: moved as FX-SHAKE-003 and turned as FX-SHAKE-009, different from both.

FX-SHAKE-011.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is amount 2, FX-SHAKE-003's frame 2, and frame 4 amount 4.

FX-SHAKE-012.says: Amount 0, rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 45 at frame 4, eased past its end (about 60 at frame 2): frame 0 is the drawing, and frame 2 is held at 45, so it is rotation 45's frame 2.

FX-SHAKE-013.says: Amount 3, seed 7, moved three pixels right: frame 0 moves the drawing 2.73 pixels left and 0.25 down, into the grown pixels, and the three columns left of the drawing show them in place; every other column is the unmoved layer's, three columns on.

FX-SHAKE-014.says: Amount 0, rotation 45, moved three pixels right: frame 0 turns the drawing 43.25 degrees anticlockwise, and its top-left corner swings down and out past its left edge into the grown pixels, shown in rows 5 to 7 of the columns left of the drawing.

FX-SHAKE-015.says: Amount 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAKE-016.says: Amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAKE-017.says: Rotation 46, above 45. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAKE-018.says: Hold 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAKE-019.says: Hold 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAKE-020.says: Seed 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAKE-021.says: Amount keyed to 1500 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
